name: Anwen
greeting: The cloths need folding. Leave the names where they are. I have moved enough things out of sight.
lines: Kael: You don't have to explain every fold.
Anwen: No. But I am learning which things I do have to explain.

actions.label: I'll put the cloths in order at the shrine.
actions.result: The loose cloths wait by the shrine bench. The recorded names are not to be moved.

relationship_event.text: Kael asked for distance after the report. He did not offer reconciliation.
relationship_event.acknowledgement: You asked for room. The work here doesn't make you owe me forgiveness.
